signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {R : Type u_2} -> {A : Type u_3} -> {B : Type u_4} -> {C : Type u_5} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [Semiring A] -> [Algebra R A] -> [Star A] -> [Semiring B] -> [Algebra R B] -> [Star B] -> [Semiring C] -> [Algebra R C] -> [Star C] -> (f : B →⋆ₐ[R] C) -> (g : A →⋆ₐ[R] B) -> A →⋆ₐ[R] C

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.comp is a total construction; it is well-defined for all pairs of composable star-algebra homomorphisms with no boundary or junk-value cases.

facts.statement: ∀ {R A B C : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Star A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R B] [Star B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R C] [Star C] (f : B →⋆ₐ[R] C) (g : A →⋆ₐ[R] B) (a b : A), VTask.comp f g (a * b) = VTask.comp f g a * VTask.comp f g b
